# PORT Magazine

> > PORT Magazine is a biannual independent culture and style publication featuring art, film, literature, photography, and fashion from leading creatives worldwide.

Based at Somerset House in London and published by Port Publishing Limited, PORT showcases contributions from renowned writers, filmmakers, and artists including Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, Daniel Day-Lewis, Will Self, and Samuel L. Jackson. The magazine accepts submissions across fiction, poetry, photography, and fashion editorials.
